note: Model mechanics use the reviewed exact pairs from all three groups together (they test how a model behaves on real pairs, not how common anything is). Population figures come from the Step 2 exact dataset.

coverage.note: Neither model can label a site with no flat ground or figure; both need the Unresolved path. Shares per group.

flatHidesFoundation.note: Pairs whose flat label (Neutral, Two-Tone, Monochromatic, Multicolor) says nothing about Light or Dark. The two-axis model keeps it for every pair.

flatHidesSaturation.note: The two-axis model moves Vibrant/Muted into secondary tags, so it loses nothing; the flat model keeps saturation only for one-chromatic pairs.

groundDependence.note: How much of each label the records alone can settle, from the 1,157 exact two-color pairs in Step 2.

fragility.note: Pairs with at least one value inside a threshold review band. The vibrant floor sits on a slope with no valley (Step 2), so labels that depend on it are the least stable.
